timestamp.name: Isiguquli sesitembu sesikhathi
timestamp.description: Guqula amasekhondi noma ama-millisecond abe izinsuku nangokuphambene endaweni yesikhathi oyikhethile.
timestamp.fallback: Indawo yesikhathi yedivayisi ayitholakali. Kusetshenziswa i-UTC; khetha indawo ngesandla.
timestamp.negative: Kwamukela uziro nezitembu zesikhathi ezingaphansi kukaziro
timestamp.stampHelp: Kuguqula njengoba uthayipha. Khetha iyunithi ngesandla kobunye ubude.
timestamp.dateHelp: Izinsuku ezingenawo umehluko wesikhathi zisebenzisa indawo yesikhathi ekhethiwe.
timestamp.rounding: Amasekhondi aphelele asondezwa phansi; ama-millisecond agcinwa.
timestamp.dst: Izinsuku ezingavumelekile nezikhathi zendawo ezingacacile noma ezeqiwe ziyenqatshwa.
timestamp.parsedOffset: Kuhunyushwe ngomehluko we-UTC kokufakiwe. Indawo ekhethiwe isetshenziselwa ukubonisa.
timestamp.invalidZone: Khetha indawo yesikhathi evumelekile ye-IANA, njenge-Asia/Shanghai noma i-UTC.
timestamp.integer: Faka isitembu sesikhathi njengenombolo ephelele yesisekelo seshumi. Izingxenyana nokubhala kwesayensi akwamukelwa.
timestamp.unknownUnit: Iyunithi ayitholakali. Khetha amasekhondi noma ama-millisecond.
timestamp.range: Isitembu sesikhathi singaphandle kwebanga elisekelwayo. Hlola inani neyunithi.
timestamp.format: Sebenzisa YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, nezinombolo ezingadluli kwezintathu ngemuva kwephoyinti, noma i-ISO ene-Z / ±HH:mm.
timestamp.invalidOffset: Usuku, isikhathi noma umehluko we-UTC akuvumelekile. Hlola zonke izingxenye.
timestamp.invalidDate: Usuku noma isikhathi asivumelekile. Hlola zonke izingxenye.
timestamp.ambiguous: Lesi sikhathi sendawo siyeqiwa noma siphindwe ekushintsheni kwendawo yesikhathi. Shintsha isikhathi noma wengeze umehluko ocacile we-UTC njenge--04:00 noma -05:00.

diagnostic.syntax1: I-JSON iqukethe uhlamvu olungasekelwa. Hlola izimpawu zokuloba, izimpawu zokucaphuna nezinhlamvu ezingabonakali.
diagnostic.syntax2: Inombolo ayivumelekile. Sebenzisa indlela yezinombolo ye-JSON, njengokuthi -12, 0.5 noma 1e3.
diagnostic.syntax3: Amagama ezakhiwo kufanele abe phakathi kwezimpawu zokucaphuna ezimbili. Ngemva kokhiye ocashuniwe, faka ikholoni nenani.
diagnostic.syntax4: Inani le-JSON alikho. Faka into, uhlu, iyunithi yombhalo, inombolo, true, false noma null; susa noma iyiphi ikhomana yokugcina.
diagnostic.syntax5: Ikholoni ayikho ngemva kwegama lesakhiwo. Faka : phakathi kokhiye nenani lawo.
diagnostic.syntax6: Ikhomana ayikho phakathi kwezakhiwo noma izinto zohlu. Faka , phakathi kwezinto ezilandelanayo.
diagnostic.syntax7: Ubakaki ogoqekile wokuvala awukho. Faka } ovala into.
diagnostic.syntax8: Ubakaki oyisikwele wokuvala awukho. Faka ] ovala uhlu.
diagnostic.syntax9: Kunokuqukethwe okwengeziwe ngemva kwenani eliyimpande. Gcina inani elilodwa eliyimpande noma ufake amanani amaningi ohlwini.
diagnostic.syntax10: I-JSON ejwayelekile ayiwasekeli amazwana. Susa amazwana e-// noma e-/* */.
diagnostic.syntax11: Amazwana awavaliwe. I-JSON ejwayelekile ayiwasekeli amazwana; susa lawo mazwana.
diagnostic.syntax12: Iyunithi yombhalo ayivaliwe. Faka uphawu lokucaphuna lokugcina bese usebenzisa izimpawu zokubalekisa ezimpawini zokucaphuna ezingaphakathi.
diagnostic.syntax13: Inombolo ayiphelele. Amachashazi edesimali nama-eksponenti kufanele alandelwe amadijithi.
diagnostic.syntax14: Uphawu lokubalekisa lwe-Unicode aluvumelekile. Sebenzisa \u olandelwa amadijithi amane e-hexadecimal.
diagnostic.syntax15: Uphawu lokubalekisa embhalweni aluvumelekile. Ngemva kwe-\, sebenzisa kuphela uphawu lokucaphuna, \, /, b, f, n, r, t noma u.
diagnostic.syntax16: Uhlamvu lokulawula alunalo uphawu lokubalekisa. Sebenzisa \n, \r no-\t ngomugqa omusha, ukubuyela ekuqaleni komugqa nethebhu.
diagnostic.DuplicateKey: Igama lesakhiwo liphindaphindiwe. Okhiye kufanele bahluke ngaphakathi kwento eyodwa.
diagnostic.EmptyInput: Okufakiwe akunalutho. Namathisela noma ngenisa i-JSON ukuze uqhathanise.
diagnostic.TaskFailed: Umsebenzi awukwazanga ukuqedwa. Zama futhi; uma inkinga iqhubeka, layisha kabusha ithuluzi.
diagnostic.NestingLimit: Amazinga okungena ngaphakathi kwe-JSON maningi kakhulu. Nciphisa amazinga noma uhlukanise idatha.
diagnostic.SizeLimit: Idatha yeqa amandla okucubungula esiphequluli. Hlukanisa ifayela noma ukhulule izinsiza zesiphequluli.
diagnostic.InvalidEncoding: Ifayela alikho ku-UTF-8 evumelekile. Ligcine njenge-UTF-8 bese ulingenisa futhi.

md5.name: Isifinyezo se-MD5
md5.title: Isifinyezo se-MD5 nokuqinisekisa
md5.description: Umbhalo, imigqa, amafayela ne-HMAC. Konke ukucutshungulwa kwenzeka esipheqululini sakho.
md5.security: I-MD5 iyisifinyezo esingabuyiseki samasheke esamba nokusebenzisana nezinhlelo ezindala. Ungayisebenziseli amaphasiwedi noma amasiginesha amelana nokushayisana. I-HMAC-MD5 iyisici sokusebenzisana.
md5.truncatedNote: Amanani okusebenzisana ezinhlamvu ezingu-16 asebenzisa izinhlamvu ze-Hex ezingu-16 ezimaphakathi, hhayi sonke isifinyezo se-MD5.
md5.limits: Umbhalo 10 MiB · imigqa engu-10,000 · amafayela angu-100 · 4 GiB ngefayela · ukhiye 64 KiB
md5.manual: Kulungile. Amafayela, amaqoqo, i-HMAC nombhalo ongaphezu kuka-256 KiB kuqalwa mathupha.
md5.batchPreview: Imiphumela yeqoqo · khetha umugqa ukuze ukopishe isifinyezo sawo
md5.linesHint: Ukuphela kwemigqa akufakwa. Izikhala, imigqa ephindaphindiwe nemigqa engenalutho emaphakathi kuyagcinwa. Ukuphela komugqa wokugcina akungezi irekhodi.
md5.fileHint: Amabhayithi aluhlaza, izingxenye ezingu-2 MiB. Amafayela anamagama afanayo ahlala ehlukene.
md5.clearKeyHint: Ukhiye uyasulwa ngemva kokuqeda, ukwehluleka, ukukhansela noma ukuphuma kuleli thuluzi.

calculator.title: Isibali
calculator.description: Izibalo ezijwayelekile nezesayensi ezinamadesimali anembile, ama-engeli namaphesenti.
calculator.expressionHint: Izibonelo: 200 + 10%, sin(30) ku-DEG, noma sin(pi/2) ku-RAD. Hlukanisa amanani afakwa emsebenzini ngokhefana.
calculator.approximate: ≈ Isibonisi siyindilinga kumadijithi abalulekile angama-24. Ikhophi isebenzisa umphumela ogcwele (kufika kumadijithi abalulekile angama-80).
calculator.precision: Isebenzisa amadijithi abalulekile angama-80. Izingxenye eziphindayo nezinombolo ezingenangqondo ziyizilinganiso zokunemba ezinomkhawulo.
calculator.businessHint: Ukukhula: okwangempela, okusha. Isaphulelo: intengo, iphesenti lesaphulelo. Yabelana: ingxenye, yonke. Thola ingxenye: yonke, iphesenti. Thola konke: ingxenye, iphesenti.
calculator.notAllowed: Lesi sisho siqukethe i-syntax noma imisebenzi engasekelwe.
calculator.tooComplex: Isisho siyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu. Lifinyeze bese uzama futhi.
calculator.nonFinite: Umphumela awuchazwanga noma ungaphandle kwebanga lezinombolo elisekelwayo.
calculator.name: Isibali
calculator.functionHelp: Ama-engeli: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan. Amalogarithimu: log10(x), ln(x), log(x, base). Eminye imisebenzi: abs, round, floor, ceil, sum, mean, min, max. Ukubhala kwesayensi: 1e-6. Khetha umbhalo ukuze uwufake ngaphakathi komsebenzi.
calculator.keyboardHint: Enter noma =: bala · Esc: sula isisho samanje
calculator.domainError: Amanani afakiwe angaphandle komkhawulo wezinombolo zangempela ezisekelwayo.
calculator.logDomain: Ilogarithimu idinga inani elingaphezu kuka-0 nesisekelo esingaphezu kuka-0 esingalingani no-1.
calculator.factorialDomain: Ifekthoriali idinga inombolo ephelele engu-0 noma ngaphezulu.
calculator.combinatoricsDomain: u-n no-r kumele kube izinombolo eziphelele ezihambisana nokuthi 0 ≤ r ≤ n.

dates.title: Isibali sosuku
dates.description: Qhathanisa nezinsuku ze-ISO, engeza izikhathi zekhalenda, ubale izinsuku zokusebenza futhi uthole nemigubho. Amadethi ahlanzekile azimele ezindaweni zesikhathi.
dates.constrain: Izibalo zenyanga nonyaka zibopha amadethi angavumelekile kuze kube usuku lokugcina lwenyanga. Isibonelo: Januwari 31 + inyanga eyodwa → Febhruwari 28 noma 29.
dates.listHint: Enter ISO izinsuku ezihlukaniswa izikhala, okhefana noma imigqa emisha. UMsombuluko–uLwesihlanu yizinsuku zokusebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo. Idethi ecacile yokusebenza ibhala ngaphezu kosuku lokuphumula, okuhlanganisa nezimpelasonto. Alikho ikhalenda leholide lezwe elisetshenziswayo.
dates.intervalHint: Ibala idethi yokuqala osukwini olungaphambi kwedethi yokuphela ngokuzenzakalela. Ububanzi obuhlehlayo bubuyisela isibalo esinegethivu. Inketho ehlanganisiwe iphinda ibale idethi yokuphela.
dates.invalidDate: Sebenzisa idethi engu-ISO evumelekile ngefomethi YYYY-MM-DD.
dates.invalidAmount: Enter inombolo yonke phakathi kuka-±1,000,000 bese ukhetha iyunithi esekelwe.
dates.rangeTooLarge: Khetha ibanga losuku lomsebenzi elifushane kuneminyaka eyi-1,000.
dates.futureOrigin: Usuku lokuzalwa noma lwesikhumbuzo akufanele lulandele idethi yesithenjwa.
dates.countdownHint: Ukuze ubale wehle, sebenzisa namuhla njengesiqalo bese ukhetha okuhlosiwe njengokuphela. Okuhlosiwe okudlule kubuyisela isibalo sezinsuku ezingezinhle. Iminyaka yokugubha unyaka isebenzisa usuku lokugcina lukaFebhuwari ngoFebhuwari 29 eminyakeni engeyona eyeqayo.
dates.name: Isibali sosuku

qr.name: Khiqiza futhi ufunde amakhodi e-QR
qr.description: Guqula isixhumanisi noma umbhalo wenze isithombe se-QR, noma funda okuqukethwe kwangempela kusuka kusithombe-skrini sekhodi ye-QR. Khetha okuthi Khiqiza noma Funda, bese wengeza okuqukethwe kwakho.
qr.generate: Guqula umbhalo noma isixhumanisi sibe ikhodi ye-QR
qr.marginHelp: Indawo ethule yamamojula amane. Izinga lokulungisa elizenzakalelayo M; ukulungiswa okuphezulu kubamba umbhalo omncane. Okukhiphayo kuyakhula uma kudingeka ukuze kulondolozwe okungenani iphikseli eyodwa module ngayinye.
qr.imageHelp: Khetha isithombe se-PNG, JPEG noma WebP (kufika ku-20 MiB nama-megapixel angu-16).
qr.drop: Dedela isithombe lapha, noma unamathisele isithombe usebenzisa ikhibhodi yakho.
qr.localHelp: Umphumela owodwa we-QR ngesithombe ngasinye. Umbhalo okhishiwe uhlala lapha; izixhumanisi azivulwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ayikho ikhamera, okulayishiwe noma izimvume.
qr.tooLong: Okuqukethwe kude kakhulu kule leveli yokulungisa. Lifinyeze noma ukhethe izinga eliphansi.
qr.invalidSize: Enter usayizi wesithombe ophelele ukusuka kumaphikiseli angu-128 kuya ku-2048.
qr.invalidLevel: Khetha L, M, Q noma H ukulungisa.
qr.notFound: Ayikho ikhodi ye-QR etholiwe. Zama isithombe esicacile, esinganqanyuliwe.

text.name: Hlanza futhi ukhiphe umbhalo
text.description: Namathisela uhlu ukuze ususe imigqa eyimpinda, ukhiphe izinombolo zocingo noma ama-imeyili, ufake umbhalo ngobuningi, noma ufihle izinkambu ezibucayi. Kopisha noma landa umphumela ohlanzekile.
text.inputHelp: Thayipha, namathisela noma udedele ifayela le-UTF-8 TXT. Umkhawulo wokufaka: 10 MiB.
text.extract: Khipha izinombolo zocingo, ama-imeyili noma izixhumanisi
text.literalHelp: Zonke izehlakalo zithathelwa indawo ngokoqobo. Izimpawu zedola nezimpawu zokukhuluma ezivamile azinancazelo ekhethekile.
text.extractHelp: Isizinda sefomethi evamile kuphela; ayiqinisekisi ubunikazi, ukulethwa noma ubunikazi. Okungenani imidlalo engu-10,000.
text.maskHelp: Ukubuka kuqala kungena esikhundleni samaphethini avamile akhethiwe. Ifoni: izinombolo zokuqala ezi-3 nezi-4 zokugcina; i-imeyili: uhlamvu lokuqala nesizinda; I-ID: izinhlamvu zokuqala eziyisi-6 nezokugcina ezi-4. Hlola umphumela ngaphambi kokwabelana; okunye okuqukethwe okubucayi akubonwa.
text.matchTruncated: Ukukhishwa kumile kumameshi angu-10,000. Yehlisa okokufaka ukuze ukhiphe okusele.
text.previewTruncated: Ukubuka kuqala kukhawulelwe ku-1 MiB. Kopisha bese ulanda kufaka phakathi umphumela ophelele.
text.invalidText: Sebenzisa umbhalo ovumelekile we-Unicode noma ifayela lombhalo le-UTF-8.
text.conversionError: Umsebenzi wombhalo wehlulekile. Hlola okokufaka bese uzama futhi.

cron.title: Cron isisho
cron.description: Qinisekisa izinkulumo Cron, yakha imithetho futhi uhlole kuqala izikhathi zokusetshenziswa zesikhathi esizayo endaweni yakho yesikhathi.
cron.builderHint: Khetha imithetho bese uchofoza okuthi Faka. Izinkambu ezithuthukile zigcina amanani azo angempela uze usebenzise izinguquko.
cron.notes: Izikhathi zokusebenza zilandela ngokuqinile isikhathi sereferensi. Izikhathi zasendaweni ezeqiwe yi-DST azisebenzi. Izikhathi zasendaweni eziphindaphindiwe zigijima kanye kuphela, ekuveleni kwazo kokuqala. Quartz iminyaka: 1970–2099. Leli thuluzi lihlola kuqala izikhathi zokwenza; ayihleli imisebenzi.
cron.syntaxLinux: Izinsuku zeviki: 0/7=NgeSonto, 1=UMsombuluko. Uma zombili izinkambu zosuku zikhawulelwe, zisebenzisa OR. ?, L, W kanye ne-# azisekelwe.
cron.syntaxQuartz: Izinsuku zeviki: 1=NgeSonto, 7=NgoMgqibelo. Inkambu eyodwa kwezimbili izinsuku kufanele ibe ?. Isekela L, L-n, nW, LW, nL kanye ne-n#1–5.
cron.descriptionFallback: Inkulumo iqinisekisiwe. Bona izincazelo zenkambu nezinsuku ezibaliwe ngezansi.
